description:
"The PedalBox turns only the front wheels, not the whole front cargo box (just like a car when making turns). This allows better stability, ease of steering, passengers' comfort, and lower center of gravity."

It's been over 10 years since we first brought Virtue SchoolBus to the market in 2012, and we feel it's a matured success product for great quality time strolling around with kids. Some inquired for a more agile sporty version of it and this year we introduced Virtue PedalBox. Over the past decade we have been receiving feedbacks, insights, suggestions from SchoolBus users and we apply them into the PedalBox. The biggest improvement, among many, would be the steering mechanism. When making turns on the handlebar, the PedalBox turns only the front wheels, not the whole front cargo box (just like a car). This allows better stability, ease of steering, passengers' comfort, and lower center of gravity.

Many parents put their kids on a small seat straped on a bike, or put them in a trailer pulled by the bike. While riding, they are not at ease maintaining stability or keep looking to the back making sure their kids/pets/belongings are safe.

Not only does Virtue PedalBox(+) put them at ease in the front, it also allows them to have good quality time chatting without the cyclist having to keep looking back. Li-ion battery powered Electric assist comes in handy when the ride gets heavy.
